items.prompt: A tropical beach party under a full moon on an island in Thailand: hundreds of dancers on the sand in silhouette, fire spinners, the moon's path across the sea, bungalows and palms dark behind.

alt.ru: Вечеринка полнолуния на тайском острове: сотни танцующих силуэтов на песке, огненное шоу, лунная дорожка на море, пальмы и бунгало в темноте.
alt.en: A full-moon beach party on a Thai island: hundreds of dancing silhouettes on the sand, fire spinners, the moon's path on the sea, palms and bungalows in shadow.
alt.pt: Uma festa de lua cheia numa ilha tailandesa: centenas de silhuetas a dançar na areia, malabaristas de fogo, o rasto da lua no mar, palmeiras e bungalows na sombra.
alt.es: Una fiesta de luna llena en una isla tailandesa: cientos de siluetas bailando en la arena, malabaristas de fuego, la estela de la luna en el mar, palmeras y bungalós en sombra.
